newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares seen drifting sideways.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares seen drifting sideways.

text.p: Singapore shares were expected to drifted sideways on Monday, dealers said.
They said the market was likely to consolidate in the absence of fresh news.
"Sentiment will be cautious because of the uncertainty on Wall Street and the weakness in Malaysian shares," said one dealer.
Last Friday, the benchmark Straits Times Industrials Index was down 2.30 points at 2075.78. The Dow rose 48.72 points to 6,526.07 last Friday after severe falls earlier that week.
